name: Qwen Image Edit 2511 (Q4)
description: Qwen's image editor: give it a picture and say what to change ("make the sky a sunset," "remove the car," "turn it into a watercolor") and it changes that and keeps the rest. It holds faces and characters steady across edits, rewrites text inside a picture, and combines up to three pictures into one. It only edits: it does not draw a picture from words alone. A 20B image transformer with Qwen2.5-VL 7B reading both the instruction and the picture: unsloth's Q4_K_M quantization, a Q4_K_M encoder and its vision projector, about 19.5 GB of downloads. Careful rather than fast: an edit takes about five and a half minutes on an RTX Spark N1X, and about nine when it combines two pictures. Apache 2.0 throughout, so fully commercial-friendly.
